source.title: Ultra Maritime deepens commitment to Royal Canadian Navy with River-class lifecycle support
source.locator: May 2026 River-class contract scope and Canadian industrial role
source.summary: Ultra Maritime reports multiple Lockheed Martin Canada awards for River-class Destroyer engineering support, spares, installation, sea trials, final acceptance, and operational-readiness activity from its Canadian business.

leads.evidenceLocator: May 2026 River-class contract scope and Canadian industrial role
followUpQuestions: Verify the authoritative contract scope, Canadian workshare, delivery and acceptance milestones, integration dependencies, production capacity, support data rights, and configuration-specific performance before comparing suppliers.
reviewWarnings: The public releases do not disclose complete contract terms, schedule risk, Canadian versus global workshare by subsystem, acceptance criteria, current production throughput, classified performance, or fleet availability outcomes.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered a material, non-duplicative fact against the exact live target.
Recovered complementary public corroboration or current-state context.
Checked English and French or Canadian public-source variants and retained only portable durable evidence.

leads.refreshSummary: Enrich Ultra Maritime Canadian undersea-warfare supply and sustainment with a material source-backed delta and explicit decision boundary.
intendedChanges: Apply one bounded additive refresh operation after human review; do not create a duplicate organization or publish autonomously.

source.summary: PSPC records a CAD 450 million five-year MWAV in-service-support award to the Thales Canada and Thales Australia joint venture, with options to extend to nineteen years and work across the Canadian fleet and supplier base.
